SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Open app where I left off
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Reopen the last section, folder or playlist with its filter. Never starts playing by itself.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Remember scroll position
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Each section, folder and playlist reopens where you scrolled to, also after closing the app

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Swipe between tabs
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Swipe left or right on the library to move between Folders, All videos, Favorites and Playlists

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Hide .ts videos
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Leave MPEG transport-stream (.ts) files out of folders, All videos, search, favorites and the video picker. Files are never changed. .mts and .m2ts aren't affected.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Hide system folders
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Skip hidden and app-data folders (like .thumbnails or Android/data)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Show watched counts
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Show watched and in-progress numbers on folders and lists

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Smart thumbnails
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: If a video's thumbnail is all black, use a real frame from inside the video

Preference.app:title: Refresh thumbnails
Preference.app:summary: Forget loaded thumbnails and load them again
